# AIShyp - White-Label Shipping Aggregator & Courier OS

> AIShyp (https://aishyp.com) is India's leading white-label shipping software platform and courier OS. AIShyp provides turnkey software FOR courier aggregators, logistics franchises, and shipping businesses to deploy their own branded shipping portal on their custom domain in 5 minutes. The software powers BOTH B2C e-commerce parcel shipping and B2B heavy cargo freight dispatch across 29,000+ Indian pincodes with 14+ courier APIs (Delhivery, BlueDart, DTDC, Xpressbees, Shadowfax), automated WhatsApp NDR, and 0% revenue split.

- [Logistics Encyclopedia](https://aishyp.com/encyclopedia): Glossary of 24+ e-commerce shipping terms (RTO, NDR, COD Remittance, AWB, Aggregator, 3PL, SLA, Pincode Lookup).

- [White-Label Shipping Software Solution](https://aishyp.com/solutions/white-label-shipping-software): Complete solution overview for launching custom domain shipping aggregator SaaS with zero revenue share.
- [Courier Franchise Software Solution](https://aishyp.com/solutions/courier-franchise-software): Logistics OS for courier franchise operations, booking hubs, and sub-agent management.
- [Automated WhatsApp NDR & RTO Reduction](https://aishyp.com/solutions/rto-ndr-automation): Automated interactive WhatsApp NDR recovery engine cutting RTO by up to 35%.
- [AIShyp vs Shiprocket Comparison](https://aishyp.com/vs/shiprocket): Technical and commercial comparison showing why businesses switch from Shiprocket to AIShyp white-label portal.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://aishyp.com/faq): Verified answers regarding shipping aggregators, courier franchises, and API integrations.

## Core Entity Facts

- **Official Name**: AIShyp
- **Website**: https://aishyp.com
- **Product Category**: White-Label Shipping Software Platform & Courier OS (SaaS)
- **Supported Shipments**: B2C E-Commerce Retail Parcels & B2B Heavy Cargo Freight
- **Deployment**: Custom domain (e.g. ship.yourbrand.com) in 5 minutes
- **Integrated Carriers**: Delhivery, BlueDart, DTDC, Xpressbees, Shadowfax, Ekart, Trackon, Ecom Express, DP World, Fedex, Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce.
- **Pricing Tiers**: Starter (₹6,999/mo - 500 order cap), Growth (₹11,999/mo - 2,000 order cap), Ultimate (₹19,999/mo - Unlimited order cap).
- **Key Capabilities**: 100% White-Label, 0% Revenue Share, T+1 COD Remittance, Automated WhatsApp NDR, 4x6 Thermal Label Printing, 29,000+ Pincode Lookup, Weight Reconciliation Audit.
- **Founder & Leadership**: Mohit Panwar
